mapper.select: SELECT current_refund_application_id,refund_application_status,refund_order_id,version,verified_at,completed_at,aftersale_status FROM pet_order WHERE id=#{order} FOR UPDATE

SELECT application_id,order_id,store_id,merchant_id,user_id,reservation_id,payment_id,payment_success_event_id,channel_trade_no, paid_amount,paid_at,created_at,merchant_deadline,applied_order_version,application_version,application_status,decision_id,decided_at FROM order_refund_application_proof WHERE application_id=#{application} FOR UPDATE
SELECT order_id,application_id,decision_id,store_id,refund_order_id,order_version,created_at,success_event_id,succeeded_at FROM order_refund_application_commit WHERE order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE order_operation_guard SET status='COMMITTED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{order} AND operation_type='CREATE_REFUND' AND token=#{token} AND status='ACQUIRED'
UPDATE order_refund_application_commit SET success_event_id=#{event},succeeded_at=#{at} WHERE order_id=#{order} AND refund_order_id=#{refund} AND success_event_id IS NULL AND succeeded_at IS NULL
